title: 🚀 Welcome to JEE Prep

sections.heading: Getting Started
sections.body:
JEE (Joint Entrance Examination) is one of the most competitive exams. It tests your fundamental understanding of Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics.

Our lessons are designed to build your concepts from scratch and challenge you with advanced problems.

highlight: Consistency is key. Study every day to see progress!

question: Which of these is fundamental to success in JEE?
explanation: JEE Advanced specifically tests conceptual depth. Mere formula application is often not enough for high-weightage questions.
